colophon.title: How this site is built.
colophon.intro: Measured, not claimed: the numbers below come from the build, the last CI run and your own browser.
colophon.type_text: Archivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono and Noto Sans Ethiopic, self-hosted and split by script, so a page downloads only the letters it shows. All under the SIL Open Font License.
colophon.weight_text: The home page’s first view downloads :js of JavaScript, :css of CSS (inlined into the HTML) and :fonts of fonts, :fonts_am in Amharic. Every build is checked against budgets of 100 KB, 20 KB and 100 KB.

colophon.lighthouse_text: Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone, lowest median across :pages pages: performance :performance, accessibility :accessibility, best practices :best_practices, SEO :seo.
colophon.privacy_text: No analytics, no ads, no third-party requests: fonts, scripts and images are all served from this domain.
